title: High cyclomatic complexity: get_injected_network_template (CCN=20)
detail: `get_injected_network_template` has a cyclomatic complexity of 20 over 82 lines (L60–165). Functions this complex are hard to test exhaustively, tend to accumulate subtle conditional bugs, and resist refactoring. Suggested fix: extract cohesive sub-operations into smaller, named functions with clear preconditions.

title: Inconsistent return statements: 4 functions mix explicit/implicit returns (L49,L60,L168,L334)
detail: Some functions return a value on some paths and fall off the end (returning `None` implicitly) on others. Callers that rely on the return value may receive `None` unexpectedly. Suggested fix: add an explicit `return` on all branches or refactor to raise on error paths.

title: Variable `netmask` possibly used before assignment at L314
detail: Variable `netmask` is assigned only in `if version == 4:` and `elif version == 6:` branches. If `version` is any other value, `netmask` is unbound when used in the `net_info` dict at L{l}. In practice version is always 4 or 6, but no assert or else-raise prevents the NameError. Suggested fix: add `else: raise ValueError(...)` before the net_info dict.
